Our values

Playing to Win

Our ambition motivates us to continuously improve and walk the extra mile while enjoying the journey. We don't stop at hard, focusing our efforts on meaningful impact, strong partnerships, and our own growth.

Sense of Urgency to be Excellent

In a rapidly changing industry, we welcome change, prioritise high-impact initiatives, and act fast. We own the outcome, consistently refining our work to make a real difference for our customers and partners.

Accountability and Cooperation

We thrive in a culture of trust and mutual respect, where individuals take ownership while supporting collective success. Collaboration across teams enables us to achieve shared goals together.

Infrastructure Engineer
Infrastructure Engineer HQ
Infrastructure Engineer HQ Salaried, full-time

About Wenrix

Wenrix is a fast-growing travel tech SaaS company which is part of eTraveli group, redefining the financial and operational backbone of the corporate and leisure travel industry. Our proven technology and AI solutions empower the global leading Online Travel Agencies and Travel Management Companies and substantially increase and improve their margins, servicing conversion rates and retention for their end customers. With exponential growth, market leading products, and a deeply experienced team, this is a great moment to join and shape the next chapter of Wenrix.


We're building a new team inside Wenrix R&D. It covers DataOps, DevOps and infrastructure: the cloud, the data platform, CI/CD, observability, and the tooling every engineer, data scientist and analyst here works with. We're adding a versatile senior infra engineer who likes trying things out and pushing them across the whole company.

This is a hands-on senior IC role. You'd be one of the team's first engineers, not its manager.

If you think something here should work differently, whether it's how we ship, how our systems perform, or what they're written in, you research it, prove it, and we roll it out together.

What Will You Do?

  • Developer experience: Build the internal tooling engineers work with every day: dev environments and the AI layer (agents, MCP servers, code assistants)
  • Data platform: Join the team behind our data pipelines. They're high volume, varied, and relied on across the company. Day to day that's Snowflake, dbt, Prefect, data quality and observability
  • Cloud and delivery: Work on our infrastructure as code (AWS, EKS, Terraform) and the path from commit to production: CI/CD, deployments, keeping what's live healthy
  • ML in production: Extend the ML infrastructure our models already run on: training and feature pipelines, serving, monitoring
  • Cost: Keep an eye on cloud spend (data and infra) and find where it can come down without slowing anyone
  • Work with backend engineers, data scientists, analysts and PMs, close enough to the business to understand the problem rather than just receive a task

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of hands-on engineering, with depth in at least one domain
  • Strong coding. We're mostly Python, and we want someone who enjoys writing code
  • A history of crossing domains: the BE who moved into DevOps, the data engineer who ended up owning infrastructure, or the startup engineer who owned everything because there was no one else
  • You can take something from idea to production and pull others along when it's bigger than you. Nobody needs to hand you a ticket
  • Big advantage: experience in one or more of Ops/DevOps, Data Engineering, ML engineering

Senior Software Engineer (Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, IL) Salaried, full-time

About Wenrix

Wenrix is a fast-growing travel tech SaaS company which is part of eTraveli group, redefining the financial and operational backbone of the corporate and leisure travel industry. Our proven technology and AI solutions empower the global leading Online Travel Agencies and Travel Management Companies and substantially increase and improve their margins, servicing conversion rates and retention for their end customers. With exponential growth, market leading products, and a deeply experienced team, this is a great moment to join and shape the next chapter of Wenrix.

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will have a key role in building a complex platform that enables innovative solutions for the travel industry. Define and build the infrastructure and products that will enable Wenrix to push our state-of-art airfare optimization products.


What Will You Do?

  • Work on hyper-growing production volume
  • Analyze, improve, and scale our systems' performance, scalability, and stability
  • Lead the architecture and development of mission-critical, diverse, and large-scale data pipelines
  • Design, develop, and test production-grade components within a micro-service architecture implemented in Python
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with the R&D, Product, and Operations teams to ensure that features meet customer needs.
  • Dive into and master the travel tech industry


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience as a software engineer
  • Practical experience in building large-scale systems
  • End-to-end feature ownership - from concept through production, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to drive delivery.
  • Working with a cloud environment (AWS is an advantage)
  • Proficient with Python (Advantage)
  • Experience in algorithm design and implementation or Machine learning (Advantage)
  • Prior experience in a technical leadership or team lead role (Advantage)


Our tech stack: Python, Kubernetes, AWS (S3, Athena, EKS, Glue, SageMaker, etc.), Spark, Postgres, Datadog, Grafana

TechOps Engineer
TechOps Engineer Tel Aviv-Yafo, Israel
TechOps Engineer Tel Aviv-Yafo, Israel Salaried, full-time

About Wenrix

Wenrix is a fast-growing travel tech SaaS company which is part of eTraveli group, redefining the financial and operational backbone of the corporate and leisure travel industry. Our proven technology and AI solutions empower the global leading Online Travel Agencies and Travel Management Companies and substantially increase and improve their margins, servicing conversion rates and retention for their end customers. With exponential growth, market leading products, and a deeply experienced team, this is a great moment to join and shape the next chapter of Wenrix.


The TechOps Engineer is a dynamic position that requires the ability to work cross functional within the company.

The lucky candidate will work closely with our Operations, Product, and R&D teams.


What Will You Do?

  • Dive deep into complex technical problems across live environments - analyzing system behavior, data flows, and configurations to drive fast, accurate resolutions.
  • Build and maintain internal automation tools, workflows, and dashboards that eliminate manual processes and improve operational efficiency across the company.
  • Work closely with GDS Specialists, Solution Architects, Product, and R&D - acting as the technical bridge between operational needs and engineering solutions.
  • Develop AI-powered tooling to automate repetitive operational tasks, surface anomalies, and accelerate investigation workflows.
  • Identify patterns in operational data and proactively translate them into scalable technical solutions before they become recurring issues.
  • Manage long-term projects and deliver on time


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in a technical operations, backend, or similar engineering role
  • Development skills in Python and/or JavaScript
  • Experience building automations and internal tooling from scratch
  • Solid technical fundamentals: SQL, log analysis, API debugging, system administration
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools and LLM-based workflows
  • Strong investigative mindset - comfortable navigating ambiguous problems across systems and data independently
  • Familiarity with GDS web services (Sabre, Amadeus, or equivalent)
  • Background in travel tech or airline/booking systems - significant advantage
  • Experience with cloud environments (AWS or equivalent) - significant advantage
